title: Measured baseline
notes: Measured baseline: ACC=60.04% (571/951), I=0.3089, S=0.4149. Paper reports 57.75%. Scoring uses all 951 samples with missing=wrong.

title: Deterministic R-sorted head selection
notes: Deterministic R-sorted head selection: -0.10 ACC vs baseline (60.04→59.94). Minor regression, keeping change.

title: Multi-scale neighborhood radii (k=4/2/1 per layer)
notes: Multi-scale k: ACC unchanged at 59.94. I slightly improved (0.3054→0.3040). No gain over IDEA-006 baseline.

title: Adaptive per-head boost factor
notes: Adaptive per-head boost: -0.42 from baseline (60.04→59.62). Stronger intervention hurts. Reverting to baseline.

title: Residual attention preservation (50/50 blend)
notes: 50/50 residual blend: -0.31 from baseline (60.04→59.73). Weakening VRGA also hurts.

title: Progressive attention boost decay (0→100 steps)
notes: Progressive decay: -0.52 from baseline. Consistent VRGA boost needed throughout generation.

title: No VRGA (base mode) diagnostic
notes: Without VRGA: ACC=59.20. VRGA baseline is 60.04, so VRGA provides +0.84 gain. Confirmed VRGA helps.

title: Switch to fa=2 binary mask mode
notes: fa=2 binary mask: +0.95 over baseline (60.04→60.99)! Target 60.64 reached! Binary mask better than neighborhood boost. All metrics improved: ACC↑, S↑, I↓.

title: Final best state (fa=2 binary mask)
notes: Final evaluation with fa=2 binary mask mode. ACC=61.20, +1.16 over baseline (60.04→61.20), +3.45 over paper-reported (57.75→61.20). Target 60.6375 exceeded.
